content.title: Easter at Capital One Center
content.text: Break out your pastels, and join us for all-things springtime, including a Color Fun Run, Easter Egg Hunt, petting zoo, and more!Easter at Capital One Center returns on Saturday, April 4th. Guests can enjoy a variety of springtime festivities all over Capital One Center including the return of our popular “Color Fun Run” (perfect for all ages), the ultimate Easter Egg Hunt with 3,000 eggs on the Great Lawn at The Perch, and so much more.Festive activities at The Perch will include:Goat Yoga class (with time for goat cuddles!) hosted by Charming Hill FarmPaint and Sip session with mimosas on the patio of Perch Putt Starr Hill’s craft brewsAdoptable puppies from Wolf Trap Animal RescueOn street level, kick off the morning with Capital One Center’s “Color Run” (offering runners and walkers the opportunity to get splattered with pastel colors during a 1-mile fun run!)‍Activities at Metro Plaza, a new plaza adjacent to the McLean Metro, will include:A meet and greet with the Easter BunnyPetting zoo from local farmSpecial experiences from Capital One Center partners including free manicures from Nothing in Between, a pop-up of Flore Cafe serving festive hot chocolate, coffee, and artisan gelato, and more.Stay for brunch and enjoy fabulous brunch specials from Starr Hill Brewpub, Sisters Tysons, Ometeo and Stellina Pizzeria. Capital One Center will transform into the ultimate springtime destination, with all the cherry blossom moments in full bloom, and you don’t want to miss it!But that’s not all: come for Easter activities, stay for Dog Man The Musical! Capital One Hall is excited to present two performances of Dog Man: The Musical on Saturday, April 4th at 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. From the pages of the best-selling graphic novel to the stage don’t miss the humor, heart, and heroic pups come to life on stage in an unforgettable musical adventure. It’s a tail wagging good time for the entire family! Tickets are on sale now!
